annotations.description:
Annotations on the node Pool.
This field has the same restrictions as Kubernetes annotations.
The total size of all keys and values combined is limited to 256k.
Key can have 2 segments: prefix (optional) and name (required),
separated by a slash (/).
Prefix must be a DNS subdomain.
Name must be 63 characters or less, begin and end with alphanumerics,
with dashes (-), underscores (_), dots (.), and alphanumerics between.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_annotations' for all of the annotations present on the resource.
annotations.rationale: annotations is not a security sensitive field

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description: The display name for the node pool.
display_name.rationale: display_name is not a security sensitive field

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.rationale: name is not a security sensitive field

on_prem_version.description: Anthos version for the node pool. Defaults to the user cluster version.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: project is not a security sensitive field

vmware_cluster.description: The cluster this node pool belongs to.
vmware_cluster.rationale: vmware_cluster is not security sensitive enough to require special handling

config.description: The node configuration of the node pool.

config.boot_disk_size_gb.description: VMware disk size to be used during creation.
config.boot_disk_size_gb.rationale: boot_disk_size_gb is not a security sensitive field

config.cpus.description: The number of CPUs for each node in the node pool.
config.cpus.rationale: cpus is not a security sensitive field

config.enable_load_balancer.description:
Allow node pool traffic to be load balanced. Only works for clusters with
MetalLB load balancers.
config.enable_load_balancer.rationale: enable_load_balancer is not a security sensitive field

config.image.description: The OS image name in vCenter, only valid when using Windows.
config.image.rationale: image does not have significant security implications

config.image_type.description:
The OS image to be used for each node in a node pool.
Currently 'cos', 'cos_cgv2', 'ubuntu', 'ubuntu_cgv2', 'ubuntu_containerd' and 'windows' are supported.
config.image_type.rationale: Selects the node OS image family (e.g. cos, ubuntu, windows). This is an operational OS choice with no single 'secure' option, so a generic platform policy cannot meaningfully constrain it; it is not a security archetype.

config.labels.description:
The map of Kubernetes labels (key/value pairs) to be applied to each node.
These will added in addition to any default label(s) that
Kubernetes may apply to the node.
In case of conflict in label keys, the applied set may differ depending on
the Kubernetes version -- it's best to assume the behavior is undefined
and conflicts should be avoided.
config.labels.rationale: labels is not a security sensitive field

config.memory_mb.description: The megabytes of memory for each node in the node pool.
config.memory_mb.rationale: memory_mb is not a security sensitive field

config.replicas.description: The number of nodes in the node pool.
config.replicas.rationale: replicas is not a security sensitive field

config.taints.description: The initial taints assigned to nodes of this node pool.

config.taints.effect.rationale: effect is not a security sensitive field

config.taints.key.rationale: key is not a security sensitive field

config.taints.value.rationale: value is not a security sensitive field

config.vsphere_config.description: Specifies the vSphere config for node pool.

config.vsphere_config.datastore.description: The name of the vCenter datastore. Inherited from the user cluster.
config.vsphere_config.datastore.rationale: datastore is not a security sensitive field

config.vsphere_config.host_groups.description: Vsphere host groups to apply to all VMs in the node pool
config.vsphere_config.host_groups.rationale: host_groups is not a security sensitive field

config.vsphere_config.tags.category.rationale: category is not a security sensitive field

config.vsphere_config.tags.tag.rationale: tag is not a security sensitive field

node_pool_autoscaling.description: Node Pool autoscaling config for the node pool.

node_pool_autoscaling.max_replicas.description: Maximum number of replicas in the NodePool.
node_pool_autoscaling.max_replicas.rationale: Sets the upper bound of nodes the node-pool autoscaler may create. This is a capacity/cost sizing choice, not a security control, and any 'reasonable number' is arbitrary and environment-specific.

node_pool_autoscaling.min_replicas.description: Minimum number of replicas in the NodePool.
node_pool_autoscaling.min_replicas.rationale: Sets the lower bound of nodes the node-pool autoscaler maintains. This is a capacity/cost sizing choice, not a security control, with no structural secure value to enforce.
